Proposed by the survey (#641); the order is D-WORKFLOW-188 (the fourth version, 2026-10-23). Run under the per-slice procedure of `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` § 6b, from the brief the planner writes before dispatch (§ 7).

## Scope

- **Area:** interface; **kind:** currency; **lens:** cost against value
- **Why here:** `es-core/src/components` (21,984 lines, 9,541 fork-own): the rows, grids, menus and cards every page is built from
- **Paths:** areas `interface`; globs `es:es-core/src/components/**`. 80 paths, 21,984 lines; 21,984 lines read, 9,541 of them fork-own (inventory at `eb4763e3cc`). The exact list is `tools/renovation-inventory --order`'s membership of `es-core-components`.
- **Provenance tiers:** fork-own 21, upstream-carried 59 (the inventory's, per file); the read's: fork-added 0, fork-modified 21, upstream-carried 59 (the brief's § 1)
- **Read before:** none (the renovation gates no release, D-WORKFLOW-187)
- **Review depth:** Independent -- an ordinary code slice
- **Interacting subsystems (read-only context):** every page; `es-code-traps.md`
